Annotation Interface Param

@Retention(RUNTIME) @Target(FIELD) public @interface Param
Marks a field of a simulation model as a setting: the HTML export shows it as a control (a slider with min and max, else a number field, a checkbox for a boolean, a choice with options, else a text field). The value is read again at every step (live) or, with restart = true, at the next setup. Settings with the same group are shown below a heading.
